reason: B is the better, though still risky, proposal because it extends a demonstrated 5 at.% Sn intervention that suppressed pesting at 800 °C and specifies quantitative oxidation and mechanical-property falsification tests. A relies mainly on alumina thermodynamics without establishing that only 5 at.% Al can form a continuous Al2O3 scale amid strongly oxidizing Hf, Ti, and Zr, and its cited evidence explicitly notes that such scale formation may be hindered.
